title: California Insurance Code Section 280 (no insurable interest, contract void)
claims: Section 280 provides that if the insured has no insurable interest, the contract is void.
Section 280 was enacted by Stats. 1935, Ch. 145.
notes: The section sits in Article 4, Insurable Interest: Generally, in the part of the Code on the insurance contract in general. For life and disability insurance, the content of an insurable interest is supplied by sections 10110 and 10110.1.
